lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: Here it is!

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: The final days before the end of the world.

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: I should probably take in the calm before...

lines.speaker: Kuwabara
lines.text: Ho-holy crap!

lines.speaker: Kuwabara
lines.text: Urameshi, look at this guy's head!

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: Oh thank god, I was getting bored.

lines.speaker: Yusuke
lines.text: Hey bug man!

lines.speaker: Yusuke
lines.text: What's your deal? Are you a demon, a monster or just some dickhead in a costume?

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: Technically all of the above.

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: But more importantly I'm the dickhead who's going to murder a couple of street toughs

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: for daring to approach my arena for the cell games!...

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: ... presented by Hetap.

lines.speaker: Yusuke
lines.text: Well excuse us, chin strap, we were under the impression that your little tournament was an open invite.

lines.speaker: Yusuke
lines.text: And between you and me...

lines.speaker: Yusuke
lines.text: ... I don't like to pass up invitations on tournaments.

lines.speaker: Yusuke
lines.text: Or to kick evil guys' asses.

lines.speaker: Kuwabara
lines.text: Yeah! Even when they're threatenin' to destroy the world!

lines.speaker: Kuwabara
lines.text: Wait, I mea- I mean *especially*!

lines.speaker: Kuwabara
lines.text: *Especially when*!

lines.speaker: Kuwabara
lines.text: You know, I think Hiei might have saved the other one.

lines.speaker: Yusuke
lines.text: Don't hurt yourself man.

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: It seems my tournament has attracted some unintended participants!

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: Then tell me, my ferocious teenage combatants:

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: What do you bring to the table?

lines.speaker: Yusuke
lines.text: With a single blast from my finger I can turn an S-rank demon into a pile of ash!

lines.speaker: Yusuke
lines.text: Or shoot little potshots between the goalposts on your head.

lines.speaker: Kuwabara
lines.text: And I have a sword!

lines.speaker: Kuwabara
lines.text: It...

lines.speaker: Kuwabara
lines.text: It cuts through...

lines.speaker: Kuwabara
lines.text: It cuts through dimensions and...

lines.speaker: Kuwabara
lines.text: It cuts through dimensions and stuff.

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: Very impressive, kids.

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: Now. Which one can blow up the planet?

lines.speaker: Yusuke
lines.text: I, uhh... What?

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: The gun or the sword!

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: Which one could literally erase the planet from existence?

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: Because I can do *that* with a finger.

lines.speaker: Yusuke
lines.text: Kuwabara, grap your crap.

lines.speaker: Yusuke
lines.text: We're going back to Genkai's.

lines.speaker: Kuwabara
lines.text: Yeah! Whatever! You're not even worth it, bug man! Heh!

lines.speaker: Yusuke
lines.text: Pompous green asshole, I'll show you what my middle finger can do...

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: They're going to have to take the bus home.

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: 'cause they're kids.
